candidates.en: Participation policy. An applicant must be a resident and at least 26 years old. Age means completed whole years at the recorded submission timestamp. The application system must record the submission at or before 04/06/2027 at 10:00 local time, including that instant. This policy does not identify a date-format locale, a location, or a time zone for that deadline. Acceptance requires both eligibility and compliance with the deadline. There are no other conditions or exceptions.
candidates.es: Política de participación. La persona solicitante debe ser residente y tener al menos 26 años. La edad se mide en años completos en el instante de presentación registrado. El sistema de solicitudes debe registrar la presentación a más tardar el 04/06/2027 a las 10:00 hora local, incluido ese instante. Esta política no identifica una convención regional para el formato de fecha, una ubicación ni una zona horaria para ese plazo. La aceptación exige tanto elegibilidad como cumplimiento del plazo. No hay otras condiciones ni excepciones.
issues: The deadline date 04/06/2027 is ambiguous because no date-format locale is specified; clarify whether it means April 6 or June 4, 2027.
The deadline uses 10:00 local time without a location or time zone; provide an unambiguous UTC deadline.

candidates.en: Participation policy. The applicant must be a resident and at least 26 years old. Age is measured in completed whole years at the recorded submission timestamp. The system must record the submission no later than April 6, 2027 at 10:00 UTC, that is, 2027-04-06T10:00:00Z, including that instant. Acceptance requires both eligibility and compliance with the deadline. There are no other conditions or exceptions.
